title: Tarihi a gabanmu
description: Ten short stories and texts about history you can touch: a retired major showing his grandson the old Zaria barracks, a history class at the Kano city walls, a grandmother's will and her hundred-year-old gold chain in Katsina, Nana Asma'u's poems on an old radio tape and a typewriter in Sokoto, a class at the site of the 1906 Satiru massacre, a boy who finds a fossil shark tooth near Sokoto, colonial files in the Kaduna archives, a caravan trader's house in Agadez, a Kano grandmother's hundredth birthday, and a climb up Dala Hill where Kano's story began.

lessons.title: Barikin Zaria
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the retired Major Lurwanu takes his grandson Bashar at dawn to the old colonial barracks where he trained: the drill field where they stood stock-still, the old tap where they washed off their sweat, the timetable on the office wall, and the photo of the barracks boxing title he won with a punch to the chest; Bashar wants to be a steady soldier like him.
lessons.text:
Manjo Lurwanu ya yi ritaya daga aikin soja shekaru da dama da suka wuce. Yanzu yana da shekara 80, amma har yanzu yana tafiya kamar matashi. Wata rana jikansa Bashar, ɗan shekara 15, ya ce masa, "Kaka, ina so in ga barikin da ka fara aikin soja a cikinsa."

Manjo Lurwanu ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "To, za mu je gobe da sassafe. A bariki, kowane aiki yana farawa da sassafe."

Washegari da sassafe suka shiga mota zuwa tsohon barikin soja na Zaria. Turawa ne suka gina wannan bariki a zamanin mulkin mallaka. Da suka isa ƙofar barikin, wani matashin soja ya tare su. Da ya ji cewa Lurwanu tsohon manjo ne, sai ya tsaya cak, ya gaishe shi irin gaisuwar soja.

Suka shiga cikin barikin. Manjo Lurwanu ya nuna wa Bashar wani babban fili. Ya ce, "A wannan fili muke yin atisaye kowace safiya. Kafin rana ta fito, shugabanmu yakan yi ihu, 'Tsaya cak!' Sai kowa ya tsaya cak, ba ya motsi ko kaɗan."

Bashar ya tambaye shi, "Har yaushe kuke yin atisayen?"

"Har rana ta yi zafi sosai. Gumi yakan zuba daga jikinmu kamar ruwan sama. Amma babu wanda ya isa ya ce ya gaji."

A gefen filin akwai wani tsohon famfo. Manjo Lurwanu ya tsaya a gabansa. "Wannan famfo yana nan tun zamaninmu!" ya ce. "Bayan atisaye, muna yin layi a gaban wannan famfo, mu sha ruwa, mu wanke gumin fuskokinmu." Ya buɗe famfon, ruwa ya fito.

Daga nan suka shiga wani tsohon ofis. A bango akwai wani tsohon jadawali. A kan jadawalin an rubuta lokacin kowane aiki: atisaye, karatu, abinci da barci. Manjo Lurwanu ya ce, "Mu ma muna da jadawali irin wannan. Duk wanda ya saɓa wa jadawalin, za a hukunta shi."

A wani babban ɗaki kuma suka ga tsofaffin hotuna. A ɗaya daga cikinsu, wani matashin soja yana riƙe da kofi. Bashar ya ce, "Kaka, kai ne wannan?"

"Ni ne," in ji Manjo Lurwanu. "A shekarar 1967 na ci kambun damben barikin nan. A wasan ƙarshe, abokin damben ya fi ni tsayi da ƙarfi. Ya nausa ni sau uku a fuska. Amma ban faɗi ba. Daga baya na nausa shi a ƙirji, sai ya faɗi. Wannan kambu shi ne abin alfaharina."

Ya ƙara da cewa, "Shugabanmu ya ce mini a lokacin, 'Kai tsayayyen mutum ne. Ba ka tsoro, kuma ba ka gudu.' Soja na gari dole ya zama tsayayye."

Da suka fito, matashin sojan da ke ƙofa ya sake tsayawa cak. Bashar ma ya tsaya cak, ya ce, "Kaka, ni ma ina so in zama tsayayyen soja kamar ka."

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Manjo Lurwanu da Bashar suka tafi bariki?
Sun tafi da sassafe.
Me sojoji suke yi a babban filin kowace safiya?
Suna yin atisaye a filin kowace safiya.
Me ya sa sojoji suke yin layi a gaban famfon?
Domin su sha ruwa, su wanke gumin fuskokinsu bayan atisaye.
Me aka rubuta a kan jadawalin?
An rubuta lokacin kowane aiki: atisaye, karatu, abinci da barci.
Yaya Manjo Lurwanu ya ci kambun dambe?
Abokin damben ya nausa shi sau uku, amma bai faɗi ba; daga baya ya nausa shi a ƙirji, sai ya faɗi.

lessons.title: Ganuwar Kano
lessons.summary: In Kano, the history teacher Malam Zulkiflu takes his class to the old city wall: historians are not certain when it was begun and hold different views, different kings who ruled Kano extended it, it was an obstacle to enemies, modern roads have cut gaps in it, and in the eastern part his student Nawal finds a deep crack and proposes writing to the government.
lessons.text:
Malam Zulkiflu malamin tarihi ne a wata makarantar sakandare a Kano. Wata safiya ya kai ɗalibansa ziyara zuwa tsohuwar ganuwar birnin Kano. Ya ce musu, "Yau ba za mu karanta tarihi a littafi ba. Za mu taɓa shi da hannunmu."

Suka tsaya a gaban wata doguwar ganuwa ta ƙasa. Malam Zulkiflu ya ce, "A da, wannan ganuwa ta kewaya tsohon birnin Kano gaba ɗaya. Tana da ƙofofi da yawa, kuma ana rufe su da dare."

Wata ɗaliba mai suna Nawal ta tambaye shi, "Malam, yaushe aka gina ta?"

Malam ya ce, "Masana tarihi ba su da yaƙini a kan haka. Ra'ayoyinsu mabambanta ne. Wasu suna cewa an fara gina ta a ƙarni na 11, wasu kuma suna cewa daga baya ne. Abin da muka sani da yaƙini shi ne, ba a gina ta a lokaci ɗaya ba. Kano ta yi sarakuna mabambanta, kuma duk waɗanda suka mulke ta sun yi aiki a kan ganuwar."

Ya ci gaba da cewa, "Da birnin ya yi girma, wani sarki ya tsawaita ganuwar, domin sababbin unguwanni su shiga ciki. Bayan shekaru da yawa, wani sarki kuma ya sake tsawaita ta. Duk sarkin da yake mulkar Kano yakan ƙara mata ƙarfi."

Nawal ta ce, "Me ya sa suke ba ta muhimmanci haka?"

"Domin a wancan zamani, abokan gaba sukan kawo hari. Ganuwar ta zama babban tarnaƙi a gare su. Ba sa iya shiga birnin cikin sauƙi. A wajen ganuwar kuma akwai wani rami mai zurfi, wanda shi ma tarnaƙi ne ga dawakan abokan gaba."

Suka kewaya wani ɓangare na ganuwar da ƙafa. A wasu wurare, sun ga giɓi a jikin ganuwar. Malam ya ce, "Wannan giɓi ba na da ba ne. An buɗe shi ne a zamaninmu, domin a gina hanyar mota. Yanzu akwai giɓi irin wannan da yawa."

Daga nan suka je gabacin birnin. A gabacin birnin, ganuwar ta fi tsawo da kyau. Amma Nawal ta ga wata babbar ɓaraka a jikinta. Ta saka hannunta cikin ɓarakar. "Malam, wannan ɓaraka tana da zurfi!"

Malam Zulkiflu ya ce, "Ruwan sama ne yake haifar da irin wannan ɓaraka kowace shekara. Idan ba a gyara ta ba, ganuwar za ta rushe. Sarakunan Kano, waɗanda suka mulke ta har shekaru ɗaruruwa, sun kare wannan ganuwa. Yanzu ita ce take buƙatar kariyarmu."

Ɗaliban suka yi shiru. Daga baya, Nawal ta ce, "Malam, za mu iya rubuta wa gwamnati wasiƙa, mu roƙe ta ta gyara ɓarakar da ke gabacin birni?"

Malam ya yi murmushi. "Wannan shi ne mafi kyawun abin da kika koya yau."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Malam Zulkiflu ya kai ɗalibansa?
Ya kai su ziyara zuwa tsohuwar ganuwar birnin Kano.
Masana tarihi suna da yaƙini a kan lokacin da aka gina ganuwar?
A'a, ba su da yaƙini; ra'ayoyinsu mabambanta ne.
Me ya sa sarakuna suka tsawaita ganuwar?
Domin birnin ya yi girma, sababbin unguwanni su shiga ciki.
Me ya sa ganuwar take da muhimmanci a da?
Domin ta zama babban tarnaƙi ga abokan gaba.
Me ganuwar ta kewaya a da?
Ta kewaya tsohon birnin Kano gaba ɗaya.
Me Nawal ta gani a gabacin birnin?
Ta ga wata babbar ɓaraka a jikin ganuwar.

lessons.title: Wasiyyar Hajiya Zahara'u
lessons.summary: In Katsina, the dignified Hajiya Zahara'u, ninety-two, whispers to her granddaughter Mufida to take what she leaves her when her time comes; after her death her son Malam Tsalha reads her will, which sets aside her hundred-year-old gold chain for Mufida; the other grandchildren grumble until he calms them by explaining that a will covers only a third and the rest is theirs.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Zahara'u ta rayu har shekara 92. A cikin garinsu na Katsina, kowa ya san ta da kamala. Ba ta taɓa yin ihu ba, ba ta yin gulma, kuma tana sa tufafi masu sauƙi amma masu tsabta. Mutane sukan ce, "Idan kana son ganin kamala, ka dubi Hajiya Zahara'u."

Jikarta Mufida ce ta fi kusa da ita. Kowace yamma Mufida takan zauna da ita a ɗakinta, tana karanta mata jarida, domin idanun Hajiya sun yi rauni ko da tana sa tabarau. Tabarau ɗinta tsoho ne sosai; ta saya shi a Kano a shekarar 1970.

Wata yamma, lokacin da Hajiya ta yi rashin lafiya sosai, ta kira Mufida kusa da ita. Ta yi mata raɗa a kunne, domin ba ta son kowa ya ji. "Mufida, idan ajalina ya yi, ki karɓi abin da na bar miki. Tarihin iyalinmu ne." Mufida ba ta gane abin da take nufi ba. Bayan kwana uku, ajalin Hajiya Zahara'u ya yi. Ta rasu cikin barci, cikin kwanciyar hankali.

Bayan kwana bakwai, 'ya'yanta da jikokinta suka taru a gidanta. Ɗanta Malam Tsalha ya fito da wata takarda. "Wannan ita ce wasiyyar mahaifiyarmu," ya ce. "Ta rubuta wannan wasiyya shekara biyar da suka wuce, a gaban shaidu biyu."

A cikin wasiyyar, Hajiya ta keɓance wasu abubuwa ga wasu mutane. Ta keɓance kuɗi ga masallacin unguwa, da kuma tabarau ɗinta ga wani tsoho maƙwabcinta. Sai kuma ta rubuta, "Sarƙata ta zinariya, wadda mahaifiyata ta ba ni a ranar aurena, na keɓance ta ga jikata Mufida."

Wannan sarƙa tana da shekara kusan ɗari. Ana cewa mahaifiyar Hajiya ta sayi sarƙar daga wani ɗan kasuwa Balarabe a kasuwar Katsina.

Sai wasu daga cikin jikokin suka fara gunaguni. Wani ya ce, "Me ya sa ita kaɗai za ta samu sarƙar?" Wata kuma ta ce, "Mu ma jikokinta ne!" Gunaguninsu ya ƙaru har ɗakin ya cika da hayaniya.

Malam Tsalha ya ɗaga hannunsa. Ya yi magana a hankali domin ya sanyaya zukatansu. "Ku saurara. A addininmu, wasiyya ba ta wuce kashi ɗaya cikin uku na dukiya. Sauran abin da ta bari kuma naku ne duka. Gidan nan naku ne, gonakin ma naku ne. Hajiya ba ta manta da kowa ba." Kalamansa sun sanyaya zukatan kowa, gunaguni ya tsaya.

Mufida ta riƙe sarƙar a hannunta. Yanzu ta gane raɗar da kakarta ta yi mata. Ta ce, "Ba zan taɓa sayar da wannan sarƙa ba. Zan ba 'yata ita wata rana, kamar yadda kaka ta yi."

Tambayoyi:
Da me mutane suka san Hajiya Zahara'u?
Kowa ya san ta da kamala.
Me ya sa Mufida take karanta wa kakarta jarida?
Domin idanun Hajiya sun yi rauni ko da tana sa tabarau.
Me Hajiya ta yi wa Mufida raɗa?
Ta ce idan ajalinta ya yi, Mufida ta karɓi abin da ta bar mata, domin tarihin iyalinsu ne.
Me Hajiya ta keɓance ga Mufida a cikin wasiyyarta?
Ta keɓance mata sarƙarta ta zinariya.
Me ya sa jikokin suka yi gunaguni?
Domin ba su ji daɗin cewa Mufida kaɗai za ta samu sarƙar ba.
Yaya Malam Tsalha ya sanyaya zukatansu?
Ya ce musu, "Sauran abin da ta bari naku ne duka."

lessons.title: Baitocin Nana Asma'u
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the university lecturer Dr. Haulatu puts Nana Asma'u's poems into her course syllabus; in her lectures she reads a stanza praising the Creator and one praising the Prophet, plays a 1975 tape on which a radio producer recorded an old woman singing the poem, and shows her father's typed copies, whose typewriter had no keys for the hooked letters; her student Abdulwaris learns a stanza by heart.
lessons.text:
Dr. Haulatu malama ce a jami'a a Sokoto. Tana koyar da adabin Hausa. A wannan zango, ta saka waƙoƙin Nana Asma'u a cikin manhajar ajinta. A da, waƙoƙin ba sa cikin manhajar jami'ar, amma ta yi ƙoƙari har aka amince.

A laccarta ta farko, ta ce wa ɗalibai, "Nana Asma'u 'yar Usman ɗan Fodio ce. Ta rayu daga shekarar 1793 zuwa 1864. Mace ce mai zuzzurfan ilimi. Ta rubuta waƙoƙi da yawa da Larabci, da Fulatanci, da kuma Hausa. Ta rubuta su da Ajami, wato da haruffan Larabci."

Sai ta karanta musu wani baiti. Wannan baiti yana yabon Mahalicci. A cikinsa, Nana Asma'u ta ce Mahalicci shi ne ya halicci sama da ƙasa, kuma shi ne yake ciyar da kowa.

Ta karanta wani baiti kuma, inda Nana Asma'u take yabon Annabi Muhammadu, sallallahu alaihi wa sallam. Dr. Haulatu ta ce, "Duk lokacin da Musulmi ya ambaci sunan Annabi, yakan ce, 'Sallallahu alaihi wa sallam.' Nana Asma'u ma ta yi haka a cikin waƙoƙinta."

Wani ɗalibi mai suna Abdulwaris ya ce, "Malama, waɗannan baitoci suna da wuyar fahimta."

Dr. Haulatu ta ce, "Gaskiya ne. Ma'anarsu tana da zurfi. Shi ya sa dole mu karanta su da zuzzurfan tunani."

A lacca ta biyu, Dr. Haulatu ta kawo wani tsohon tef da tsohuwar na'urar kunna tef. Ta ce, "A shekarar 1975, wani furodusa a gidan rediyon Sokoto, Malam Bilya, ya naɗi muryar wata tsohuwa tana rera waƙar Nana Asma'u a kan wannan tef. Furodusan ya ce tsohuwar ta koyi waƙar ne daga kakarta."

Ta kunna tef ɗin. Muryar tsohuwar ta cika ɗakin laccar. Ɗalibai suka yi shiru suna saurare.

Bayan haka, Dr. Haulatu ta nuna musu wasu tsofaffin takardu. "Mahaifina ya rubuta waɗannan waƙoƙi a keken rubutu a shekarun 1960. Amma keken rubutunsa ba shi da madannin haruffan Hausa masu ƙugiya. Saboda haka, duk inda yake buƙatar waɗannan haruffa, sai ya rubuta su da hannu. Ku duba: wasu madanni ma sun karye, shi ya sa wasu haruffa ba su fito sosai ba."

Abdulwaris ya ce, "Malama, wannan tarihi ne da za mu iya taɓawa da hannunmu!"

A laccar mako na gaba, Abdulwaris ya tsaya a gaban aji, ya rera baiti ɗaya na Nana Asma'u ba tare da ya duba takarda ba. Dr. Haulatu ta yi murmushi. Ta ce, "Wannan shi ne dalilin da ya sa na saka waƙoƙinta a cikin manhaja."

Tambayoyi:
Me Dr. Haulatu ta saka a cikin manhajar ajinta?
Ta saka waƙoƙin Nana Asma'u a cikin manhajar ajinta.
Wace ce Nana Asma'u?
'Yar Usman ɗan Fodio ce, mace mai zuzzurfan ilimi wadda ta rubuta waƙoƙi da yawa.
Me baiti na farko yake yabo?
Yana yabon Mahalicci.
Wa ya naɗi muryar tsohuwar a kan tef?
Wani furodusa a gidan rediyon Sokoto, Malam Bilya, ne ya naɗi muryarta.
Me ya sa mahaifin Dr. Haulatu ya rubuta wasu haruffa da hannu?
Domin keken rubutunsa ba shi da madannin haruffan Hausa masu ƙugiya.
Me Abdulwaris ya yi a laccar mako na gaba?
Ya rera baiti ɗaya na Nana Asma'u ba tare da ya duba takarda ba.

lessons.title: Kisan kiyashi na Satiru
lessons.summary: Near Sokoto, the history teacher Malam Abdulkahar takes his class to the empty site of Satiru and tells how in 1906 the villagers, angered by heavy taxes and colonial contempt, followed a man who claimed to be the Mahdi; the British declared the group unlawful, the villagers beat a small force with bows and arrows, then a larger force with the Sultan's troops massacred them, and the Sultan cursed the land so no harvest was taken from it; his student Rafi'a asks how they know the story is true.
lessons.text:
Malam Abdulkahar malamin tarihi ne a Sokoto. Wata rana ya kai ɗalibansa wani fili kusa da birnin, inda ƙauyen Satiru yake a da. Yanzu babu gida ko ɗaya a wurin.

Malam ya ce, "Ku saurara. Abin da zan ba ku labari a kai ya faru a nan, a shekarar 1906, shekara uku bayan Turawa sun ci Sokoto da yaƙi."

"A wancan lokaci, wani malami a Satiru ya ce shi ne Mahadi. Mutane da yawa suka bi shi, musamman manoma talakawa. Turawan mulkin mallaka suna karɓar haraji mai nauyi, kuma suna nuna wa jama'a raini. Wannan raini ya ɓata wa mutane rai sosai."

"Turawa suka ce ƙungiyar mutanen Satiru haramtacciya ce. Domin haramtacciyar ƙungiya ce a idonsu, suka aika ƙaramar runduna zuwa ƙauyen. Mutanen ƙauyen ba su da bindigogi. Suna da kibiya da baka, da mashi, da fartanya kawai. Duk da haka, sun ci rundunar, suka kashe wasu Turawa da sojojinsu."

"Bayan wata ɗaya, Turawa suka dawo da babbar runduna, tare da dakarun Sarkin Musulmi. Da sassafe suka kai wa ƙauyen hari da manyan bindigogi. Kibiya ba ta iya komai a gaban bindiga. Aka yi kisan kiyashi a wurin: an ce an kashe mutane fiye da 2,000, har da mata da yara."

Wata ɗaliba mai suna Rafi'a ta ce, "Tir! Tir da wannan kisan kiyashi!" Sauran ɗalibai ma suka ce, "Tir!"

Malam ya ci gaba: "Bayan kisan, Sarkin Musulmi na lokacin ya tsine wa ƙasar Satiru. Ya ce kada a sake gina ƙauye a nan, kuma kada a yi noma a gonakinta. Saboda haka, an ce shekaru da yawa ba a yi girbi a wannan ƙasa ba. Manoma suna tsoron tsinuwar."

Rafi'a ta bijiro da wata tambaya: "Malam, ta yaya muka san wannan labari gaskiya ne?"

Malam ya ce, "Tambaya ce mai kyau. Kada ku gaskata kowane labari sai kun bincika shi. Mun samu wannan labari daga wurare biyu: daga takardun Turawan da kansu, da kuma daga labaran da tsofaffin Sokoto suka bayar. Domin wurare biyu sun faɗi abu ɗaya, masana tarihi sun gaskata shi."

Wani ɗalibi kuma ya bijiro da wata tambayar: "Shin Sarkin Musulmi ya yi daidai da ya tsine wa ƙasar?" Malam ya ce, "Masana tarihi ba su yarda a kan haka ba."

Kafin su tafi, ɗaliban suka tsaya shiru na minti ɗaya domin tunawa da waɗanda aka kashe. Rafi'a ta ce, "Ba za mu manta da Satiru ba."

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe kisan kiyashi na Satiru ya faru?
Ya faru a shekarar 1906.
Me ya sa mutane da yawa suka bi malamin Satiru?
Domin Turawa suna karɓar haraji mai nauyi, kuma suna nuna wa jama'a raini.
Me Turawa suka ce game da ƙungiyar mutanen Satiru?
Sun ce haramtacciyar ƙungiya ce.
Da me mutanen ƙauyen suka yi yaƙi?
Sun yi yaƙi da kibiya da baka, da mashi, da fartanya.
Me ya sa ba a yi girbi a ƙasar Satiru ba shekaru da yawa?
Domin Sarkin Musulmi ya tsine wa ƙasar, kuma manoma suna tsoron tsinuwar.
Me ya sa masana tarihi suka gaskata labarin?
Domin takardun Turawa da labaran tsofaffin Sokoto sun faɗi abu ɗaya.

lessons.title: Haƙorin shark
lessons.summary: Near Sokoto, twelve-year-old Yasin stumbles over a stone while herding goats and finds a sharp black tooth in it; at the university Professor Sadauki tells him it is a fossil shark tooth from a sea that covered the area sixty million years ago, explains how sharks bite and swallow fish, cleans the stone in mild acid, and tells him that ants bring small fossils up from the ground; the tooth goes on show with Yasin's name.
lessons.text:
Yasin ɗan shekara 12 ne. Yana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Sokoto. Kowace yamma bayan makaranta, yakan kai awakin mahaifinsa kiwo a wani wuri mai duwatsu a wajen ƙauyen.

Wata yamma, Yasin yana gudu a bayan awakin, sai ya yi tuntuɓe a kan wani dutse, ya kusa faɗuwa. Da ya juya domin ya ga dutsen da ya sa shi tuntuɓe, sai ya ga wani abu a cikinsa. Abu ne ƙarami, mai launin baƙi, mai siffar haƙori, kuma yana da kaifi sosai.

Ya kai shi gida, ya nuna wa kakansa. Kakansa ya juya shi a hannunsa. "Tuntuɓe ba faɗuwa ba ne," ya ce yana dariya. "Amma ban san wannan abu ba. Bari mu kai shi jami'a."

Kakansa ya kai shi jami'a a Sokoto. A can, Yasin ya haɗu da Farfesa Sadauki, masanin kimiyyar duwatsu. Farfesan ya duba abin sosai, sannan ya ce, "Yasin, wannan haƙorin shark ne!"

"Shark?" Yasin ya ce. "Amma babu teku a Sokoto!"

Farfesa Sadauki ya yi murmushi. "Yanzu babu. Amma shekaru miliyan 60 da suka wuce, wani teku ya rufe wannan ɓangare na ƙasarmu. Babu makawa, mahallin wannan wuri ya canza ƙwarai. A da, mahallin kifaye ne da shark; yanzu kuma mahallin awaki ne da mutane."

"Wow!" Yasin ya ce. "Shark ya taɓa iyo a nan?"

"Ƙwarai kuwa. Duba yadda haƙorinsa yake da kaifi. Shark yakan ciji kifi da irin waɗannan haƙora. Idan ya ciji babban kifi, yakan yanke shi biyu. Ƙananan kifaye kuma yakan haɗiye su gaba ɗaya, ba tare da ya ciza su ba. Idan ya haɗiye su, ba sa sake ganin rana."

Farfesa ya kai Yasin ɗakin gwaji. A can ya saka dutsen a cikin ruwan acid mai sauƙi. "Wannan acid ba ya cutar da haƙorin," ya ce, "amma yana cire ƙasar da ta manne masa." Bayan kwana biyu, suka fito da shi daga acid ɗin. Haƙorin ya fito fili, yana sheƙi. Yasin ya sake cewa, "Wow!"

Farfesa ya ƙara da cewa, "Ka san cewa tururuwa suna taimaka mana a wannan aiki? Lokacin da tururuwa suke gina gidajensu, sukan fito da ƙananan duwatsu daga cikin ƙasa, har da ƙananan haƙoran kifi. Babu makawa, idan ka duba gidan tururuwa da kyau, za ka iya samun irinsu."

Yanzu haƙorin shark ɗin yana cikin gidan tarihi na jami'ar. A gefensa an rubuta: "Yasin ne ya same shi." Kowace yamma, lokacin da Yasin yake kiwo, yakan duba gidajen tururuwa da kyau.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Yasin ya sami haƙorin?
Ya same shi a cikin wani dutse da ya sa shi tuntuɓe a wajen ƙauyensu.
Me Farfesa Sadauki ya ce abin yake?
Ya ce haƙorin shark ne.
Me ya sa akwai haƙorin shark a Sokoto?
Domin shekaru miliyan 60 da suka wuce, wani teku ya rufe wannan ɓangare na ƙasar.
Me shark yake yi da ƙananan kifaye?
Yakan haɗiye su gaba ɗaya, ba tare da ya ciza su ba.
Me acid ɗin ya yi wa dutsen?
Ya cire ƙasar da ta manne wa haƙorin.
Yaya tururuwa suke taimaka wa masana?
Sukan fito da ƙananan duwatsu da haƙoran kifi daga cikin ƙasa lokacin da suke gina gidajensu.

lessons.title: Fayilolin Kaduna
lessons.summary: The student Siddiƙa goes to the national archives in Kaduna to research Kano's Sabon Gari in the early 1950s; on the veranda she reads stamped colonial files: a police report on Indian hemp, a complaint by a coalition of wealthy traders who wanted prostitutes moved from houses near the market, and a letter from the elected councillor Alhaji Ɗanhaki saying the British officer had no authority to evict anyone without a court; the old archivist Malam Sharu explains that power was in British hands.
lessons.text:
Siddiƙa ɗaliba ce a jami'a a Zaria. Tana rubuta kundin digirinta a kan tarihin unguwar Sabon Gari ta Kano a farkon shekarun 1950. Domin ta samu bayanai na gaskiya, ta tafi gidan adana tarihi na ƙasa a Kaduna, inda ake ajiye takardun gwamnatin Turawa.

A can, ta haɗu da Malam Sharu, wani tsoho mai kula da takardun. Malam Sharu ya kawo mata fayil goma sha biyu. Kowane fayil tsoho ne, takardunsa sun yi ruwan ɗorawa. A kan kowane fayil kuma akwai hatimin gwamnatin Turawa. Malam Sharu ya ce, "Ki riƙe su a hankali. Wasu daga cikinsu sun kai shekara 75."

Saboda zafi a cikin ɗakin, Malam Sharu ya ba ta izini ta zauna a baranda. A barandar akwai tebur da kujera, da iska mai daɗi. Ta buɗe fayil na farko.

A cikin fayil na farko, ta karanta rahoton 'yan sanda. A shekarar 1951, 'yan sanda sun kama wasu matasa da wiwi a kasuwar Sabon Gari. Wani Bature ya rubuta cewa shan wiwi ya ƙaru a unguwar, kuma doka ta haramta shi.

A fayil na biyu, ta karanta cewa wata gamayyar 'yan kasuwa ta rubuta wa Bature takardar ƙorafi. A cikin gamayyar akwai wadatattun 'yan kasuwa na Kano. Waɗannan wadatattun 'yan kasuwa suna so a kori karuwai daga wasu gidaje kusa da kasuwa, domin suna ganin waɗannan karuwai suna ɓata sunan unguwar.

A fayil na uku, ta samu wata wasiƙa daga Alhaji Ɗanhaki, zaɓaɓɓen ɗan majalisar garin Kano. A matsayinsa na zaɓaɓɓen wakilin jama'a, ya rubuta cewa Bature ba shi da hurumin korar kowa daga gidansa ba tare da kotu ba. "Ko da karuwai ne," ya rubuta, "wannan hurumin kotu ne, ba na Bature ba."

Siddiƙa ta yi mamaki. Ta tambayi Malam Sharu, "Shin Bature ya saurari Alhaji Ɗanhaki?"

Malam Sharu ya yi dariya. "A wancan lokaci, madafun iko suna hannun Turawa. Ko da zaɓaɓɓen ɗan majalisa ya yi magana, Bature ne yake da ƙarshen magana. Sai bayan 'yancin kai madafun iko suka koma hannun 'yan ƙasa."

Ta duba wasiƙar sosai. A ƙasanta akwai hatimin majalisar garin Kano da kuma sa hannun Alhaji Ɗanhaki. Ta ɗauki hoton kowane shafi da wayarta. Ta ce wa Malam Sharu, "Wannan fayil zai zama zuciyar kundina."

Tambayoyi:
Me Siddiƙa take rubutawa?
Tana rubuta kundin digirinta a kan tarihin Sabon Gari ta Kano.
Me yake kan kowane fayil?
A kan kowane fayil akwai hatimin gwamnatin Turawa.
Me ya sa Siddiƙa ta zauna a baranda?
Saboda zafi a cikin ɗakin.
Me gamayyar 'yan kasuwa take so?
Tana so a kori karuwai daga wasu gidaje kusa da kasuwa.
Me Alhaji Ɗanhaki ya rubuta?
Ya rubuta cewa Bature ba shi da hurumin korar kowa daga gidansa ba tare da kotu ba.
A hannun su wane ne madafun iko suke a wancan lokaci?
Madafun iko suna hannun Turawa.

lessons.title: Gidan kakansu a Agadez
lessons.summary: In Agadez, Ghaicha shows her cousin Akli, who works in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates, their grandfather's mud house, now a small museum: the old carpets from North Africa, the iron scale for weighing goods by the kilo, the olive oil his camel caravan brought back, and the prayer room he set to face the qibla by the stars; then they buy cheese, apples and grapes in the packed market.
lessons.text:
Ghaicha tana zaune a Agadez, a Jamhuriyar Nijar. Ɗan uwanta Akli yana aiki a Dubai, a Haɗaɗɗiyar Daular Larabawa. A wannan shekara, ya zo Agadez hutu bayan shekara biyar.

Ghaicha ta ce masa, "Ka manta da Agadez a cikin dogayen gidajen Dubai. Bari in kai ka gidan kakanmu."

Kakansu ɗan kasuwar ayari ne. Shekaru 80 da suka wuce, ayarinsa na raƙuma yakan ratsa hamada zuwa Libiya. Yanzu gidansa na laka ya zama ƙaramin gidan tarihi.

A ɗakin baƙi, ƙasa ta rufe da tsofaffin kafet masu launin ja da shuɗi. "Kakanmu ya sayo waɗannan kafet daga Arewacin Afirka," Ghaicha ta ce. "A da, baƙi sukan zauna a kan kafet, su sha shayi, su yi ciniki." Akli ya taɓa wani kafet. "A Dubai ma akwai irin wannan kafet, amma ba su kai na kakanmu tsufa ba."

A wani ɗaki kuma akwai tsohon ma'auni na ƙarfe. "Da wannan ma'auni kakanmu yake auna kaya da kilo," Ghaicha ta ce. "Ayarinsa yakan kai gishiri kilo dubu da yawa zuwa Libiya. Daga can kuma yakan dawo da man zaitun, tufafi da shayi." Akli ya ce, "Man zaitun! A gidana na Dubai ba na girki sai da man zaitun."

Kusa da ɗakin akwai ƙaramin ɗakin sallah. Bangon ɗakin ya fuskanci alƙibla. Ta wata ƙaramar taga, ana ganin hasumiyar babban masallacin Agadez. Ghaicha ta ce, "Kakanmu ya gina ɗakin nan ya fuskanci alƙibla daidai, ba tare da wata na'ura ba. Ya gane alƙibla ne daga taurari."

Bayan sun bar gidan, suka je babbar kasuwar Agadez. Kasuwar ta makare da mutane, raƙuma da kaya. Akli ya ce, "Kai, kasuwar nan ta makare kamar kasuwannin Dubai!"

Suka sayi cukun Agadez, wanda ake yi da madarar akuya. Suka kuma sayi kilo biyu na tuffa da ɗan inabi. Mai sayarwar ta ce motoci ne suke kawo tuffa da inabi daga Libiya yanzu, ba raƙuma ba. Akli ya ɗanɗana cuku, ya ce, "Zan kai wannan cuku Dubai. Abokaina na Haɗaɗɗiyar Daular Larabawa za su ɗanɗana Agadez."

Ghaicha ta yi dariya, ta ce, "To, kada ka manta: tarihinka yana nan Agadez, ba Dubai ba."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Akli yake aiki?
Yana aiki a Dubai, a Haɗaɗɗiyar Daular Larabawa.
Me kakansu yake yi shekaru 80 da suka wuce?
Ɗan kasuwar ayari ne; ayarinsa na raƙuma yakan ratsa hamada zuwa Libiya.
Daga ina kakansu ya sayo kafet?
Ya sayo su daga Arewacin Afirka.
Me ayarin kakansu yake dawowa da shi daga Libiya?
Yakan dawo da man zaitun, tufafi da shayi.
Yaya kakansu ya gane alƙibla?
Ya gane alƙibla ne daga taurari.
Yaya kasuwar Agadez take?
Kasuwar ta makare da mutane, raƙuma da kaya.
Me suka saya a kasuwa?
Sun sayi cukun Agadez, kilo biyu na tuffa, da ɗan inabi.

lessons.title: Kaka mai shekara ɗari
lessons.summary: In Kano, Hajiya Asibi turns a hundred: she recovered from tuberculosis at twenty-two thanks to Patrick, a priest and doctor from Europe, and from cancer at eighty; when her granddaughter Afnan brings a white birthday cake, she laughs and teaches her to cook the food of her youth, masa from dough with a tomato and garlic stew, fatty meat and fried chicken gizzards.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Asibi ta cika shekara ɗari a wannan shekara. An haife ta a Kano a shekarar 1925, a zamanin mulkin mallaka. Ta ga abubuwa da yawa a rayuwarta: mota ta farko a unguwarsu, 'yancin kan Najeriya, har da wayar hannu.

Da take da shekara 22, ta kamu da tarin fuka. A wancan lokaci, tarin fuka cuta ce mai kisa; mutane da yawa sun mutu da ita. Tana tari ba dare ba rana, kuma ta rame sosai. Mahaifinta ya kai ta wani ƙaramin asibiti da wani firist daga Turai ya kafa a wajen birnin. Firist ɗin, Patrick, likita ne kuma. Ya ba ta wani sabon maganin tarin fuka kowace rana har wata shida. A hankali, ta murmure. Ta ce, "Firist ɗin bai taɓa tambayar addinina ba. Sai dai ya ce, 'Ki murmure, shi ne kawai abin da nake so.'"

Bayan shekaru 58, da take da shekara 80, likitoci suka gano tana da kansar nono. An yi mata aiki, aka ba ta magani na wata takwas. Ta sake murmurewa. Ta ce, "Kansar ta zo, kansar ta tafi. Allah ne ya ba ni ƙarfi."

A ranar cikarta shekara ɗari, jikokinta suka taru a gidanta. Jikarta Afnan ta kawo babban cake mai launin fari, an rubuta "100" a kansa. Hajiya Asibi ta dubi cake ɗin, ta yi dariya. "Cake abincin Turawa ne! Bari in koya muku abincin da muke ci a zamanina."

Ta zauna a kan kujera a ɗakin girki, tana gaya wa Afnan abin da za ta yi. Na farko, Afnan ta fito da kullu na masa, wanda ta haɗa tun jiya da dare, kamar yadda kakarta ta ce. "Kullu na masa yana buƙatar ya kwana," Hajiya ta ce. "Idan kullu bai kwana ba, masa ba za ta yi daɗi ba."

Sai suka yi miya. Afnan ta yanka tumatir, albasa da tafarnuwa. "Ki ƙara tafarnuwa," Hajiya ta ce. "Tafarnuwa magani ce." Afnan ta soya tumatir da tafarnuwa a cikin mai. Sannan ta saka naman rago mai kitse. "Kada ki cire kitse duka," Hajiya ta ce. "Kitse yana ba miya daɗi."

A ƙarshe, Hajiya ta ce, "Ina ƙundun kazar?" Ƙundun kaza shi ne abin da ta fi so tun tana yarinya. Afnan ta soya ƙundu biyar, ta ba ta.

Da aka gama, kowa ya ci masa da miyar tumatir, har da yara. Afnan ta ce, "Kaka, wannan ya fi cake daɗi!" Hajiya Asibi ta yi dariya, sannan ta ɗauki ɗan cake kaɗan. "Na murmure daga tarin fuka da kansar; ba zan ƙi cake ba," ta ce.

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe aka haifi Hajiya Asibi?
An haife ta a Kano a shekarar 1925.
Wace cuta ta kama ta tana da shekara 22?
Ta kamu da tarin fuka.
Wa ya ba ta magani har ta murmure?
Wani firist daga Turai mai suna Patrick, wanda likita ne kuma.
Me Afnan ta kawo a ranar cikar Hajiya shekara ɗari?
Ta kawo babban cake mai launin fari.
Me ya sa Hajiya ta ce kada a cire kitse duka?
Domin kitse yana ba miya daɗi.
Me Hajiya Asibi ta fi so tun tana yarinya?
Ta fi son ƙundun kaza.

lessons.title: Dutsen Dala
lessons.summary: On a Sallah holiday in Kano, Aziza climbs Dala Hill with her uncle Malam Jamaluddeen along a stony path; a shepherd boy rescues a sheep stuck on a rock, they eat bananas at the top under the clouds, and her uncle tells how before Islam the people of Dala worshipped the idol Tsumburbura, how the cult leader Barbushe watched the clouds, and how they brought it black animals as sacrifices for rain and a good harvest.
lessons.text:
Aziza 'yar shekara 14 ce. Tana zaune a Legas tare da iyayenta, amma a hutun Sallah ta zo Kano wurin kawunta, Malam Jamaluddeen. Wata safiya kawun ya ce, "Yau za mu haye Dutsen Dala. A nan ne tarihin Kano ya fara."

Dutsen Dala yana tsakiyar tsohon birnin Kano. Ba shi da tsawo sosai, amma turbarsa tana da duwatsu da yawa. Suka bi wata ƙaramar turba wadda take karkata zuwa sama.

Da suka kai rabin dutsen, sai suka ga wani yaro yana kiwon tumaki. Wata tunkiya ta haye wani babban dutse, ta kasa saukowa. Tunkiyar tana kuka. Yaron ya haye dutsen, ya ɗauko ta a hannunsa. Aziza ta yi dariya. "Ita ma tunkiyar tana so ta ga Kano daga sama!"

Suka ci gaba da hawa. Gumi yana zuba daga goshin Aziza. Da suka kai saman dutsen, suka zauna a kan wani dutse. Kawunta ya fito da ayaba guda huɗu daga jakarsa. Suka ci ayaba suna kallon birnin. A sama, gajimare ya rufe rana, iska mai sanyi ta fara kaɗawa.

Malam Jamaluddeen ya ce, "Shekaru dubu da suka wuce, kafin Musulmai su zo Kano, mutanen Dala suna bauta wa wani gunki mai suna Tsumburbura. Gunkin yana cikin wata babbar bishiya a nan kusa. Shugaban masu tsafin shi ne wani mutum mai suna Barbushe. Yana zaune a saman wannan dutse."

"Me suke yi wa gunkin?" Aziza ta tambaya.

"Sukan kawo masa hadaya. Littafin tarihin Kano ya ce hadayarsu baƙaƙen dabbobi ne: baƙin kare, baƙar kaza, baƙar akuya. Suna ganin idan sun yi hadaya, gunkin zai ba su ruwan sama da girbi mai kyau. Barbushe yakan tsaya a nan, ya duba gajimare, ya faɗa wa mutane abin da zai faru a shekarar."

"Yanzu kuma fa?" Aziza ta tambaya.

"Daga baya, da Musulmai suka zo, mutane suka bar tsafi, suka bar bauta wa gunki. Amma har yanzu ana ba da labarin Barbushe da tsafinsa."

Gajimare ya wuce, rana ta sake fitowa. Aziza ta ga rufin gidaje masu yawa, da hasumiyar masallaci, da kuma ganuwar birnin a nesa. Ta ce, "Kawu, yanzu na gane me ya sa ka ce tarihin Kano ya fara a nan."

Suka sauka ta wannan turba. A ƙasan dutsen, yaron nan mai tumaki ya ɗaga musu hannu.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ya kai Aziza Dutsen Dala?
Kawunta, Malam Jamaluddeen, ne ya kai ta.
Me ya faru da tunkiyar yaron?
Ta haye wani babban dutse, ta kasa saukowa, sai yaron ya ɗauko ta.
Me suka ci a saman dutsen?
Sun ci ayaba guda huɗu.
Wane gunki ne mutanen Dala suke bauta wa a da?
Suna bauta wa wani gunki mai suna Tsumburbura.
Me ya sa mutane suke kawo wa gunkin hadaya?
Suna ganin gunkin zai ba su ruwan sama da girbi mai kyau.
Wane ne shugaban masu tsafin?
Shugaban masu tsafin shi ne Barbushe.
